info.title: Webmania API2 documented fiscal file delivery
info.description: Sixteen documented file URLs across NFSe, CT-e/CT-e OS and correction events, MDF-e, NFCom and DC-e. These return media and optional redirects/pending JSON, not the issuer JSON envelope. Explicit access choices are server alternatives, not SDK fallback behavior.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Existing fiscal document identifier, preserved as a string. CC-e routes identify the correction event. Do not guess unrelated customer identifiers.

200.description: Select representation by actual Content-Type and status. JSON, PDF, XML, ZIP and HTML are distinct results; HTTP 200 alone does not mean a file was returned.

default.description: Invalid identifier, unavailable document, cancellation not completed, expired link token, missing recipient or denied company access; status and safe context are preserved.

get.x-sdk-authentication-policy: Choose one explicit access mode before requesting. Never retry with another scheme, fall back from rejected Bearer to anonymous, copy an issuer Bearer into the query token or substitute Monitor/reseller credentials. MDF-e supports company Bearer in this SDK contract only.
x-sdk-transfer-policy: Use the fixed public origin and a non-browser SDK User-Agent. Do not execute returned HTML.
Preserve status, media type, safe headers and raw bytes without JSON decoding, text transcoding or trimming binary content.
Use bounded response size/timeouts. Distinguish a JSON error or pending result from a successful binary transfer.
Do not automatically follow a response URL or redirect, or forward authentication to another origin. Query tokens and downloaded fiscal contents are sensitive.

Do not infer that bytes delivered without explicit credentials are unprotected: recipient password, ambient authorized IP and panel session are server-controlled. Never claim SDK authentication from an ambient-network success.
get.description: Public guide supports company Bearer, an existing encrypted per-document link token, authorized issuing IP/panel context, and protected anonymous delivery where a recipient exists. XML without established access is returned as password-protected ZIP; PDFs may be password-protected. No recipient means these public/protected modes may be denied.

FiscalFileCompanyBearer.description: Existing company-scoped API2 Bearer matching the document issuer; its company scope is compared with the document. A Monitor account token or API1 reseller credentials are not substitutes.

FiscalDocumentLinkToken.name: token
FiscalDocumentLinkToken.description: Existing encrypted per-document sharing token from the documented DFeToken flow, valid 24 hours and unavailable without a recipient. This is not an API Bearer token. Never log its value, generate a replacement implicitly or advertise it for MDF-e.

FiscalFileError.description: Functional/file errors may use HTTP 200. A present error field is failure, never file bytes. Redact tokens, credentials and sensitive URL queries in diagnostics.

NfsePdfPending.description: Municipal PDF is still being retrieved. HTTP 200 JSON is a pending result, not a PDF or fiscal authorization. A later explicit read may succeed; no hidden retry loop.
